From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mediva security questionnaire and initial notes

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list and the VSA. Great conversation this morning. Recap + answers for Procurement/InfoSec to reference: 

Quick recap of Redwood controls relevant to your asks:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security and Availability) audit in June 2025. We can share the SOC 2 report under NDA; will provide a secure link or upload to your portal once NDA is in place.
- GDPR / DSARs: We support data-subject requests via our API and console; typical verification + fulfill window is 30 days, with an internal SLA to acknowledge within 3 business days.
- HIPAA / BAA: We offer BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted accounts we evaluate on a case-by-case basis; happy to loop legal if Mediva requires a full BAA for hosted workloads.
- Deletion & backups (summary): primary data deletion: removed from primary storage within 24 hours of a validated delete; request logs and short-term caches removed within 72 hours. Backups: incremental backups retained for 30 days by default; optional archival (90 days) available with an add-on. Full backup purge window can be up to 60 days depending on snapshot retention overlap — we will provide exact wording for procurement.

Attachments: RI_Compliance_Summary_0806.pdf (summary of controls + exportable evidence list).

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood to complete the VSA and return by EOD Aug 21. Priyom will own the questionnaire answers and coordinate SC access.
2) If you need the SOC 2 report now, please send an NDA link; we will upload the report within 48 hours of executed NDA.
3) Procurement: please confirm the exact deletion clause you want (timing / certificate of deletion) and we will surface a suggested clause for legal.
4) Schedule a 30–45 minute deep-dive with our security engineering team next week (demo of audit portal, retention controls, and backup lifecycle). Suggested slots: Aug 18 or Aug 19 afternoon PT.

Priyom: please start populating the VSA and pull any supporting evidence from the compliance vault. Stephanie: want you to review the proposed backup purge language before we send back.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales (Security & Compliance)

Thanks Karthik — that helps a lot. A couple quick clarifications from Procurement before we kick off the VSA: 

- Deletion SLA: they asked whether "backups" are included in the same deletion SLA as primary data. Specifically they want a contractual guarantee that customer-initiated data deletions will be completed end-to-end within 30 days including backups, and a certificate of deletion. Is that something Redwood will commit to?
- For HIPAA: Mediva intends to run PHI in a Dedicated environment if BAA terms are acceptable; can you confirm lead time and typical timelines for Dedicated onboarding (capacity + compliance paperwork)?

We're fine with an NDA for SOC 2 — I'll circulate that today if you confirm the right upload address. Also happy to take Aug 18 afternoon for the deep-dive.

Sarah

Subject: INTERNAL: Action items for Mediva VSA + procurement asks

Internal note — summary of what to prepare and suggested language to send back to Mediva. This message is internal only; do not forward to customer until we agree.

Background: Mediva is evaluating Redwood for chat/embedding workloads; they will likely require PHI handling on Dedicated. Primary asks from Procurement/InfoSec: SOC 2 report (under NDA), explicit deletion SLA covering backups, BAA for Dedicated, and detailed retention/backup lifecycle.

Proposed responses / tasks: 
1) VSA: Priyom to own. Target return date: 2026-08-21 COB. Use the compliance vault doc set and pull evidence IDs: SEC-2025-SOC2, LOG-ROTATION-2024, BACKUP-ENCRYPT-STMT. Attach RI_Compliance_Summary_0806.pdf and mark redlines where evidence is pending.

2) Deletion SLA language (suggested): "Redwood will execute validated customer-initiated data deletion requests such that data is removed from primary production storage within 24 hours and propagation to immutable backup snapshots will complete within 30 calendar days. Redwood will provide a certificate of deletion upon completion. For customers requiring extended archival purge windows, Redwood offers a configurable snapshot-retention add-on (up to 90 days)."

3) Backups & encryption: Confirmed — backups are AES-256 encrypted at rest, and we use envelope encryption for key management (KMIP-compatible KMS). Priyom: include the KMS provider info and HSM details in the questionnaire.

4) SOC 2 report: we can upload to their portal after NDA. Stephanie: prepare the redaction guidance and the secure share link (expires in 7 days).

5) Dedicated onboarding: Typical lead time 6–8 weeks after contract signature for capacity + network onboarding; compliance paperwork (BAA) can be executed in parallel. Karthik: commit to sharing a short procurement timeline with Mediva by EOD Aug 15.

Next steps for internal: Priyom to draft questionnaire responses by Aug 18; Stephanie to review deletion wording & SOC redaction; Karthik to reply to Mediva with suggested deletion clause and confirm Aug 18 deep-dive slot.

Attachments to include in next outbound: RI_Compliance_Summary_0806.pdf (controls matrix), suggested deletion SLA clause, SOC NDA template link.

Thanks — Karthik
